ready.title: Ready for Test
ready.noTestCasesHint: Go to ⚗ Data Generator to select APIs and generate synthetic test cases, or import test data from a file.
ready.flowDesc: 10 API calls executed according to the dependency graph and HTTP method order (POST → GET → PATCH → DELETE). IDs generated by each POST request are automatically propagated and reused in subsequent API calls.
ready.independentDesc: Executes each API independently, without dependency chaining. Synthetic data generated by the system is attached directly to each request. No previous response is required before the next API request can be executed.
ready.flowDetail: Each API call waits for the previous response. Timeout applies per request in the dependency chain.
ready.independentDetail: Each request runs with its own generated payload and does not depend on IDs or responses from previous calls.
ready.envAllCalls: All REST calls will be sent to the selected base URL
ready.resetTitle: Reset all results back to pending — test cases are preserved, only execution state is cleared
ready.reRunTitle: Re-run all tests from scratch using stored URLs
ready.saveCsvPending: Save pending test cases as CSV
ready.saveCsvExecuted: Save executed test cases with results (resolvedUrl, status, body, headers)
ready.importCsvTitle: Import test cases from CSV (app export format)
ready.generateBashTitle: Generate curl shell script for {{mode}} execution
ready.unresolved: ⚠ Some test cases have unresolved {id} placeholders — click to review
ready.invalidHeaders: Invalid JSON — fix headers before running
ready.prodWarning: PRODUCTION endpoint selected — test execution will hit live data
ready.unresIdDesc: Some test cases still contain {id} placeholders — real IDs are only available after a flow execution run. The script will use random seed IDs (1–50) for those calls.
ready.saveCsvQuestion: 📄 Save test data CSV alongside the script?
